# @marknotton/yoink-core

> A headless, UI-free TypeScript engine for downloading video with yt-dlp. It finds links in text, builds yt-dlp commands, parses yt-dlp's output into progress, runs single and batch jobs, handles sites that need a login, and reports errors as codes. A host app supplies only a small Runner (start yt-dlp, stream its lines). Zero runtime dependencies; no DOM or Node APIs.

Use the package; do not copy or rewrite its logic. Render `Job` objects and write your own UI wording from `Job.error.code`.

## Install
- Tarballs from a GitHub Release (`packages-vX.Y.Z`) or npm. Install `@marknotton/yoink-core` and `@marknotton/yoink-runner-node` together (the runner has the core as a peer dependency). NOT from the git repo: see README.

## Related packages
- @marknotton/yoink-runner-node: Runner for Node (child_process), plus a cookies-file Authenticator

## Key facts
- Entry point: `createYoink({ runner, outputDir, storage?, authenticator?, policy?, concurrency? })`
- Methods: probe, download, batch, getJobs, cancel, retry, dismiss, clearFinished, subscribe, idle, signIn, signOut, signedIn
- Job status: queued | fetching | running | done | error
- Error codes: NEEDS_LOGIN | UNAVAILABLE | NO_FORMATS | CANCELLED | FAILED
- Only platform-specific code: the Runner. Never run yt-dlp or parse its output yourself.
